rust_summary: a player's throw with the whole stack (`native_item_dropped_v2`), leaving `native_item_dropped` as it was.
doc_summary: `native_item_dropped_v2(player, stack)`: an additive version of `native_item_dropped` with the whole stack thrown, its components included (enchantments, unbreakable, attribute modifiers...). Heard just before v1, which keeps its signature and firing point. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:item_dropped_v2@`.
